script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(p.id AS CHAR), 'exchange_rate', p.exchange_rate, 'exchange_rate_currency', p.exchange_rate_currency,
       'po_status', p.po_status, 'approve_flow_status', p.approve_flow_status, 'purchase_order_no', p.purchase_order_no,
       'po_supplier_id', p.po_supplier_id, 'po_currency', p.po_currency, 'po_plant', CAST(p.po_plant AS CHAR), 'organization_id', p.organization_id,
       'acc_integration_type', p.acc_integration_type, 'po_payment_terms', CAST(p.po_payment_terms AS CHAR), 'po_description', p.po_description,
       'po_remark', p.po_remark, 'po_remark2', p.po_remark2, 'po_remark3', p.po_remark3, 'po_remark4', p.po_remark4, 'po_remark5', p.po_remark5,
       'po_billing_address', p.po_billing_address, 'po_shipping_address', p.po_shipping_address, 'billing_address_name', p.billing_address_name,
       'billing_address_phone', p.billing_address_phone, 'billing_address_line_1', p.billing_address_line_1,
       'billing_address_line_2', p.billing_address_line_2, 'billing_address_line_3', p.billing_address_line_3,
       'billing_address_line_4', p.billing_address_line_4, 'billing_address_city', p.billing_address_city,
       'billing_postal_code', p.billing_postal_code, 'billing_address_state', CAST(p.billing_address_state AS CHAR),
       'billing_address_country', CAST(p.billing_address_country AS CHAR), 'billing_attention', p.billing_attention,
       'billing_address_fax', p.billing_address_fax, 'shipping_address_name', p.shipping_address_name,
       'shipping_address_phone', p.shipping_address_phone, 'shipping_address_line_1', p.shipping_address_line_1,
       'shipping_address_line_2', p.shipping_address_line_2, 'shipping_address_line_3', p.shipping_address_line_3,
       'shipping_address_line_4', p.shipping_address_line_4, 'shipping_address_city', p.shipping_address_city,
       'shipping_postal_code', p.shipping_postal_code, 'shipping_address_state', CAST(p.shipping_address_state AS CHAR),
       'shipping_address_country', CAST(p.shipping_address_country AS CHAR), 'shipping_attention', p.shipping_attention,
       'shipping_address_fax', p.shipping_address_fax, 'project_id', CAST(p.project_id AS CHAR),
       'custom_fields_b3w85tmv', p.custom_fields_b3w85tmv) AS j
  FROM purchase_order p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_pocvStart.data.tenantId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0
   AND p.id IN ({{node:code_node_pocvStart.data.idsSql}})
 ORDER BY p.id

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('doc', CAST(p.id AS CHAR), 'id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'parent_id', CAST(l.parent_id AS CHAR), 'quantity', l.quantity,
       'unit_price', l.unit_price, 'discount', l.discount, 'discount_amount', l.discount_amount, 'tax_amount', l.tax_amount,
       'po_amount', l.po_amount, 'discount_uom', l.discount_uom, 'tax_preference', CAST(l.tax_preference AS CHAR), 'tax_percent', l.tax_percent,
       'tax_inclusive', l.tax_inclusive, 'invoice_qty', l.invoice_qty, 'payment_term_id', CAST(l.payment_term_id AS CHAR), 'item_id', l.item_id,
       'item_name', l.item_name, 'item_bundle_id', CAST(l.item_bundle_id AS CHAR), 'item_desc', l.item_desc, 'more_desc', l.more_desc,
       'received_qty', l.received_qty, 'quantity_uom', CAST(l.quantity_uom AS CHAR), 'line_remark_1', l.line_remark_1,
       'line_remark_2', l.line_remark_2, 'item_category_id', CAST(l.item_category_id AS CHAR), 'tariff_id', CAST(l.tariff_id AS CHAR),
       'further_description', l.further_description, 'project_id', CAST(l.project_id AS CHAR),
       'custom_fields_va4w0xz3', l.custom_fields_va4w0xz3) AS j
  FROM purchase_order p
  JOIN purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub l ON l.purchase_order_id = p.id AND l.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_pocvStart.data.tenantId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0
   AND p.id IN ({{node:code_node_pocvStart.data.idsSql}})
 ORDER BY p.id, l.id
